name: Character State Tables - Dynamic Character Data Management

parameters.responseBody:
={{ {
  success: true,
  characterId: $json.characterId,
  level: $json.level,
  hp: { current: $json.hpCurrent, max: $json.hpMax },
  mp: { current: $json.mpCurrent, max: $json.mpMax },
  xp: { current: $json.xpCurrent, toNext: $json.xpToNext },
  conditions: $json.conditions,
  inventory: { weight: $json.inventoryWeight, value: $json.inventoryValue },
  spellSlots: { used: $json.spellSlotsUsed, max: $json.spellSlotsMax },
  metadata: $json.metadata,
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
} }}
